newsitem.title: USA: General Binding buys equity stake in GMP.
newsitem.headline: General Binding buys equity stake in GMP.

text.p: Desktop laminator General Binding Corp said on Thursday it has become an equity shareholder in GMP Co Ltd, a South Korean desktop laminator, for undisclosed terms.
The companies will form an alliance to develop and market desktop lamination equipment and supplies worldwide, General Binding said.
In addition to GMP, General Binding bought during the past 12 months a digital printing company in Madison, Wisconsin, and an Australian distributor of business machines and supplies.
The company has said it expects its new acquisitions to strengthen its 1996 performance.
